title: Chinese embassy to Filipino lawmakers: 'You are now on the list'
summary: The Chinese Embassy in Manila issued agressive statements on Tuesday amid renewed calls from several Philippine lawmakers to declare Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan “persona non grata”.
